name: Delilah
summary: A woman in the valley of Sorek whom Samson loved. The lords of the Philistines paid her to learn the secret of his strength, and she gave him into their hands.

key_moments.title: Paid to Find His Strength
key_moments.description: The lords of the Philistines each promised Delilah eleven hundred pieces of silver if she could find out what made Samson strong and how to bind him.

key_moments.title: Three False Answers
key_moments.description: Three times Samson told Delilah a false secret: seven fresh cords, new ropes, and his hair woven into a loom. Each time she called the Philistines, and each time he broke free.

key_moments.title: Samson Tells Her All
key_moments.description: Delilah pressed Samson daily until he told her all his heart. She made him sleep on her knees, had his seven locks shaved, and the Philistines seized him.
